privacyPolicyText:
Last Updated: May 31, 2025

## 1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how TeamMind AI ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects information in relation to TeamMind, our AI-powered knowledge management and documentation automation service (the "Service"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. We follow a "Privacy by Design" approach and process only the minimum information necessary to provide our service.

## 2. Information We Collect

### 2.1 Account Information
When you register for an account, we collect information such as your name, email address, company name, and account login credentials.

### 2.2 Content and Usage Data
To provide the Service, we collect and process:
- Content you upload, submit, store, send, or receive through the Service
- Data from your company's integrated tools, including meetings, chats, emails, and documents
- Service usage information, including basic log data and device information

### 2.3 AI Processing Data
Our Service uses artificial intelligence to process your content. This may include analyzing text, identifying topics, generating summaries, and recognizing information discrepancies across systems.

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information solely to:
- Provide, maintain, and improve the Service
- Process and analyze company knowledge to provide AI-powered features
- Communicate with you about the Service
- Protect the security and integrity of the Service
- Comply with legal obligations

### 3.1 Use of Google Workspace Data

**Important Clarification for Google Workspace Integration:**

We DO NOT use data obtained through Google Workspace APIs (including Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Meet, or any other Google Workspace services) to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or ML models that could benefit other users or customers.

Specifically:
- Your Google Workspace data is processed solely to provide our Service to you and your organization
- We do not use your Google Workspace data to improve our AI models for use by other customers
- We do not use your Google Workspace data to train generalized machine learning models
- Your Google Workspace data is not used to enhance our Service for other users beyond your own organization
- All AI processing of your Google Workspace data is performed exclusively to deliver the specific features and functionality of our Service to you

Your Google Workspace data remains your property and is processed only as necessary to provide our knowledge management and documentation automation features to your specific account and organization.

## 4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your information based on:
- Contract performance: Processing necessary to provide the Service
- Legitimate interests: To improve our Service and ensure security
- Consent: Where applicable and required by law
- Legal obligations: To comply with applicable laws and regulations

## 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure

We may share your information with:
- Service providers who help us deliver the Service
- Legal authorities, when required by law or to protect our rights

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

## 6. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information. Our database, frontend, backend, and base model inference systems are SOC 2 hosted, and we are IS27701 ready. We use cookies only for essential login/logout functionality.

## 7. Data Retention

We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. We may retain certain information after account closure to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce agreements.

## 8. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:
- Access personal information we hold about you
- Correct inaccurate information
- Delete your personal information
- Object to or restrict certain processing
- Data portability
- Withdraw consent

To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information in the "Contact Us" section.

## 9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the new policy on our website or through the Service. Your continued use of the Service after such notice constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

## 10. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

faq.question1: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.answer1: Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial. You can cancel at any time during the trial period without being charged.
faq.answer2: You can cancel your subscription at any time. This can be done easily from your account settings.
faq.question3: Where can I find my invoices?
faq.answer3: Your invoices can be found in your account settings under the 'Invoices' section.
faq.question4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer4: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for business customers.
faq.question5: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer5: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. This can be done from your account settings under 'Subscription'.
faq.question6: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
faq.answer6: Yes, we offer a 50% discount for non-profit organizations. Please contact us for more information.
faq.question7: How does TeamMind protect my company's sensitive data?
faq.answer7: TeamMind employs multi-layered security measures, including end-to-end encryption, role-based access control, and regular security audits. We are ISO27701 ready and meet the highest security standards for enterprise data.
faq.question8: Which tools and platforms can TeamMind integrate with?
faq.answer8: TeamMind integrates seamlessly with over 30 common business tools, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira, Confluence, Trello, Asana, and many more.
faq.question9: How quickly can TeamMind be implemented in our company?
faq.answer9: The setup of TeamMind typically takes only 20 minutes and can be done with just a few clicks.
faq.question10: Do you offer custom integrations for our existing software?
faq.answer10: Yes, we offer custom integrations for your specific software. Our development team works closely with you to create tailored solutions that meet your requirements.
faq.question11: How does the AI automatically update our documentation?
faq.answer11: TeamMind's AI continuously analyzes your communication sources (meetings, chats, emails) and identifies relevant information, decisions, and changes. These are automatically incorporated into the appropriate documents, taking context and relevance into account. When uncertainties or contradictions arise, the team is notified for manual review.
faq.answer12: TeamMind currently fully supports English, German, French, Spanish, and Italian. Additional languages are being added continuously. The AI can process and analyze content in over 20 languages, even if the user interface is displayed in a different language.
faq.question13: Is TeamMind suitable for small businesses or only for large enterprises?
faq.answer13: TeamMind is designed for companies of all sizes. We offer special plans for small teams (starting from 5 employees) up to solutions for large enterprises with thousands of employees. The platform's scalability adapts to your company size.
faq.question14: What technical requirements are needed to use TeamMind?
faq.answer14: As TeamMind is a cloud-based solution, you only need a modern web browser and an internet connection. No additional software installation is required. For some advanced integrations, API access to your existing tools may be needed.
faq.question15: How does TeamMind help with onboarding new employees?
faq.answer15: TeamMind significantly accelerates the onboarding of new employees by allowing them to find relevant company information through simple questions in natural language. New team members no longer need to search through numerous documents or interrupt colleagues, instead receiving precise answers instantly from the company's knowledge base.
